subject: Media Literacy
title: Deepfakes as Propaganda Tools
description: Learn Deepfakes as Propaganda Tools in one minute.

hook.text: A video shows a world leader declaring war. The speech never happened. The face is AI-generated.

buildup.text: Deepfakes use AI to create realistic fake videos of people saying or doing things they never did.

discovery.text: A deepfake of Ukraine's president telling soldiers to surrender was posted during the 2022 Russian invasion.

twist.text: Deepfakes create a 'liar's dividend' — real footage can be dismissed as fake, destroying all trust.

climax.text: When nothing looks fake and everything can be faked, evidence-based truth becomes nearly impossible.

punchline.text: You can't trust your eyes anymore.

quiz.question: What is the 'liar's dividend' of deepfakes?
options: Real footage can be dismissed as fake, eroding all trust
